howto: Press Play, then tap (or press Space) to smash down through the platform below the ball.
Tap again in mid-air to slam down faster for bonus points.
Coloured parts break. Landing on a black part ends the run.
tips: Watch the front edge of the next platform: tap just after a black part passes.
Slams in a row build a streak worth +5 bonuses.
Landing right next to a black part counts as a close call.
Gaps in the tower drop you straight to the next solid platform.
Gems add points and climb your gem rank; the bright elite gems are worth +15.

controls.keyboard: Space or Down arrow smashes, press again in the air to slam. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Tap anywhere to smash, tap again in mid-air to slam

difficulty: An adaptive curve: every two platforms down adds another black part (up to five), and the platforms spin faster the deeper you go.

cheats.effect: Steel ball: black parts break like the rest
Slow spin: platforms turn at half speed
Big ball: a giant ball that grabs gems from further away

features.one-tap-start: Play, then the first tap smashes and starts the run
features.instant-restart: Play Again on the Cracked card starts a new run at once
features.best-score-badge: Best pill in the top bar during play, and on the Cracked card
features.tutorial-card: Get-ready card with a tapping finger; the first run also explains slams and black parts
features.results: Cracked card with score, best, slam streak, close calls, gems and depth
